_comment: Copy to config.json (or point to another path via the UROBOROS_CONFIG environment variable). This file contains only database and skill_dir; other config such as LLM goes through environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: the UROBOROS_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose one of two forms: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) provide only database.dsn, a single complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): delete the database above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: The skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing a SKILL.md). Priority: the UROBOROS_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > the default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave blank or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
